name: Main

messages.text: Create projects/test-product.md — the master plan for projects/test-product.html — following the house planning-doc standard. Requisite sections, in order: (0) TURN/STAGE LEDGER: a table of turns/stages with status, where every future build session appends a row before touching code; (1) RELEASES: numbered release list with one-line goals; (2) per-release sections: scope (in/out), build gates (how we verify, on real devices), and backlog of deferred items; (3) FUTURE IDEAS: unscheduled parking lot; (4) IMMUTABLE WORKING RULES: mobile-first, all diagnostics in-app (never DevTools), update-plan-before-code, read-back verification after every push, no stubs or fake data; (5) DECISION LOG: dated owner decisions; (6) APPENDIX: authority order (this plan is the sole authority; chat history loses to the plan). Seed it with what is known so far about projects/test-product.html and mark everything else TBD. Keep it tight and scannable on a phone.

Created the master plan file with all required sections in order, seeded with the few facts we know (single-file mobile-first HTML app at projects/test-product.html) and everything else marked TBD until you decide the app's purpose. Next step: tell me what the app should do, and I'll fill in Release 1 and build a first playable version.
